title: Model policy-specific transport
frozenQuestion: Can policy-specific actor velocity, blocked-action collision load, experienced positional flux, and residence time predict composition-corrected aggregation trajectories in held-out mixtures, compositions, value-association constructions, and kinetic interventions?

scope.sourcePopulation: S07 frozen holdout corpus: 186 conditions x 25 scenarios x 6 regimes
scope.target: paper-denominator same-policy adjacency minus the validated S02 exact-composition expectation
scope.predictiveUse: retrospective trajectory prediction from complete-run transport summaries; not online forecasting

mechanisticConstraint.s11r: S11R found no support-qualified completion-feasible value perturbation in its frozen ladder; S12 carries this as a component-separation constraint and does not repair or reopen that intervention.
mechanisticConstraint.s11: S11 Shapley quantities are excluded from features, targets, model fitting, adequacy decisions, and causal interpretation.
mechanisticConstraint.claimBoundary: Predictive adequacy does not identify a unique transport mechanism, mediation path, or causal effect.

transportDefinitions.actorVelocity: For policy k, total absolute actor-to-target displacement from accepted swaps initiated by k divided by actor activations of k; positions per actor activation.
transportDefinitions.collisionLoad: For policy k, native no-op activations plus intervention-gate rejections divided by actor activations. It is an operational blocked-action/no-op load, not a literal physical impact count.
transportDefinitions.experiencedFlux: For policy k, absolute displacement experienced by every identity of k, including target displacement, divided by policy count and total system activations/10000; positions per cell per 10,000 activations.
transportDefinitions.residenceTime: For each identity, 100 divided by one plus the number of accepted-swap-grid transitions at which its position changed; average within policy. Units are percentage points of accepted-swap progress and the measure is interval-censored at the 1% grid.
transportDefinitions.missingPolicyRule: Absent policies have zero-valued transport fields and a separate present indicator; no undefined value is imputed from outcomes.

split.developmentConditions: native_control, absent association, pairwise p20_80 through p80_20 plus balanced_rotating three-way
split.nativeCompositionHoldout: native_control absent-association pairwise p10_90/p90_10 and all rare_*_10 three-way conditions
split.nativeAssociationHoldout: native_control positive and negative policy-value association at every composition
split.interventionHoldout: all non-native S07 regimes and all 186 conditions; activation_equal is the sole calibration-feasible confirmatory intervention, while displacement_equal, target_range_equal, success_equal, and joint_equal are descriptive stress tests
split.isolation: All model family and hyperparameter selection uses development fit/calibration rows only. External native and intervention outcomes remain unopened by the fitting stage until the selected model is refit, serialized, and hashed.

modelFamilies.meanShape: simple baseline: development mean change-from-initial trajectory shifted to each scenario's observed initial corrected aggregation
modelFamilies.staticRidge: simple covariate baseline: ridge regression from pre-outcome features to 12-component PCA trajectory scores
modelFamilies.transportRidge: ridge regression from pre-outcome plus transport features to 12-component PCA trajectory scores
modelFamilies.transportForest: 300-tree ExtraTrees multi-output regression from pre-outcome plus transport features to the same PCA scores
modelFamilies.transportMarkov: coarse first-order ridge state model for one-step aggregation change using current predicted aggregation, progress basis, and frozen static/transport summaries; evaluated by recursive rollout

modelSelection.criterion: lowest calibration condition-mean trajectory RMSE among transportRidge, transportForest, and transportMarkov; ties within 0.0001 select the simpler family in that order: transportRidge, transportMarkov, transportForest
modelSelection.refit: refit the selected frozen family and strongest simple baseline on all development fit plus calibration scenarios before hashing and opening external outcomes

endpoints.primary: condition-mean trajectory RMSE over all 101 points
endpoints.uncertainty: pointwise 90% split-conformal bands from development calibration condition-mean absolute residuals; report empirical held-out coverage

adequacyCriteria.classification: supportive only if every native-external and activation_equal gate passes; null if absolute error gates pass but transport does not improve enough over the strongest baseline; constraining/contradictory if absolute native or activation intervention adequacy fails

failureRegions.flag: group RMSE above its applicable frozen maximum or group primary-model RMSE at least 10% worse than the strongest baseline

validation: S01-S11R artifact-manifest hash and file hash immutability
raw S07 row accounting and scenario/regime pairing
zero split overlap and exact frozen condition/replicate assignment
recalculated corrected adjacency equals the stored S07 trajectory
residence bounds and deterministic feature extraction
complete prediction, metric, residual, and condition accounting
focused tests and deterministic model replay
